usedFor: Zoho CRM holds the leads, and “New Lead” there starts “Create Task” in Amwork for follow-up.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Zoho CRM, then “Create Task” in Amwork
bestTemplate.why: Every lead from Zoho CRM becomes an Amwork task, so nobody has to remember to start follow-up.

watchOut: “New Lead” in Zoho CRM is polling, so “Create Task” in Amwork starts after a scheduled check.
